asset.name: Access expired
asset.description: Sent to the requester when time-boxed access is removed at the end of its period.
asset.subject: Access removed: {{application}} ({{role}})
asset.html_body:
Time-boxed access has ended

Hi {{requester_name}},

The {{duration}} grant of {{role}} on {{application}} for {{user_name}} (grant {{grant_id}}) has expired and was removed.

Submit a new request if the access is still needed.

Sent by your access request workflow
